title: Turn extreme logits into stable probabilities
description: A quick reference for the stable-normalization, log-probability, and numerical-range terms used here.

terms.definition: An unnormalized class score produced before conversion into a probability distribution.
A normalization that converts grouped logits into nonnegative probabilities summing to one.
Subtracting a group's largest logit before exponentiation to improve numerical stability.
The class values normalized together along one explicitly selected tensor axis.
The tensor axis whose entries represent competing choices in one probability distribution.
A stable log-domain summary of exponentiated logits within one normalization group.
The logarithms of normalized softmax probabilities computed without avoidable intermediate rounding.
The negative log-probability assigned to one selected target class.
A finite-precision failure where a computed magnitude exceeds the representable range.
A finite-precision effect where a tiny nonzero magnitude rounds down to zero.
